summary: Frontend-only landing page tested end-to-end. Verified direct browser POSTs to both GHL LeadConnector webhooks with correct payloads, no backend /api/leads calls, validations, success state, hero VSL blue border, and smoke checks (testimonials, FAQ, no console errors). All requested checks passed.
critical_code_review_comments: goStep3() fires the form webhook via axios.post(...).catch(() => {}) without awaiting — good for UX (non-blocking) and errors are silently swallowed. Consider logging errors to aid debugging if webhook delivery fails.
REACT_APP_LEAD_WEBHOOK_URL / REACT_APP_APPOINTMENT_WEBHOOK_URL are read at build time; if either env is missing, axios.post(undefined,...) will throw. A guard/default would harden the code.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only architecture: AppointmentForm posts directly to two GHL webhooks (env: REACT_APP_LEAD_WEBHOOK_URL, REACT_APP_APPOINTMENT_WEBHOOK_URL). Do NOT expect /api/leads calls. Success panel [data-testid='apply-success'] appears only after appointment webhook returns 200. Revenue option text uses en dash '$2M – $5M'.
